subtype: Approach: learning from past failure as data [Thinking]
passage: Charu, you asked how I stopped being a mess after the biology paper, and honestly I made a table. Left column: the exam in July, where I did well. Right column: this one. Sleep: seven hours in July, five this time. How I studied: summary sheets and a weekly test in July; this time I only reread. Stress: in July I was worried but fine; this time I was in a panic from Monday. Then I realised this wasn't "I'm stupid." It was data. Sleep, method, panic: three things I can change. I'm Binita, and looking at that page I felt something like relief, because the failure had turned into a to-do list.
